items.b: PANDORA OPENS $150 MILLION VIETNAM PLANT, CAPACITY UP 50%
items.t: The Ho Chi Minh City site opened 1 October, Pandora's first outside Thailand and its fourth worldwide, with room for 60 million pieces a year and 7,000 local jobs when fully operational.

items.b: BOODLES TAKES ARGYLE'S BRAND, ONCE OVER 90% OF PINK SUPPLY
items.t: Rio Tinto put no price on the transfer, completed 1 October. Boodles also acquired the last remaining Argyle pink-diamond inventory, a suite of trademarks, the website and the digital marketing assets.

items.b: AUDEMARS PIGUET LAUNCHES 18 JEWELS, NONE OF THEM A WATCH
items.t: Royal Oak Joaillerie opened at Paris Fashion Week in gold and titanium. No retail price was published. One cuff carries 506 diamonds, 19 amethyst cabochons and 16 black spinel cabochons.

items.b: PLATINUM ADDS $17 TO $1,725 ON THE 1 OCTOBER MARK
items.t: Silver added $0.381 to $61.062 and gold $15.00 to $4,183.90 against the same mark. Palladium was exactly unchanged at $1,170.00, with a $40.00 quoted spread against gold's $2.00.
